floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_tail.what: fgw with the embryo tail decoder: every panel gene below the scorer's 0.25 reference level whose predicted change is negative is topped up towards a flat change (one factor per gene, each cell's expected panel total kept, factors above 2 skipped)

fgw_geoshares.what: fgw with its draw edited the least so that each state's (obs['group']) share of the drawn cells follows exponential growth between the brackets, p_before^(1 - t) p_after^t renormalised, at the entry's bracket counts
